blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the next four terms of the sequence: \(12, 16, 20, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan sequence ke pehle teen terms diye gaye hain aur humein agle chaar terms likhne hain. Sequence (silsila) ka matlab hai numbers ki aisi list jo kisi pattern (qaida) par chalti hai.
Sab se pehle hum dekhenge ke har term se agla term kaise banta hai: kitna barhta ya ghatta hai.
Agar yeh farq har dafa ek jaisa hai to wohi pattern aage chaar dafa laga denge. Yahan terms barh rahe hain, is liye farq positive aayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: terms \(12, 16, 20, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: agle chaar terms, yani 4th, 5th, 6th aur 7th term.
Tareeqa: Har term mein se pichla term minus kar ke farq (difference) nikalenge. Agar farq har jagah ek hi hai to pattern pakka hai, aur aakhri diye gaye term se shuru kar ke yeh farq bar bar lagayenge.

Lagataar terms ka farq nikalein
\[16 - 12 = 4\]
\[20 - 16 = 4\]
Kyun: Doosre term mein se pehla aur teesre mein se doosra minus kiya. Dono jawab \(4\) aaye, matlab har agla term pichle term mein \(4\) jama karne se banta hai. Sirf ek farq dekh kar pattern pakka nahi hota; do farq barabar hon to yaqeen ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: hamesha baad wala term minus pehla term karein, ulta karne se sign badal jata hai.

Yahi qaida chaar dafa aur lagayein
\[a_4 = 20 + 4 = 24\]
\[a_5 = 24 + 4 = 28\]
\[a_6 = 28 + 4 = 32\]
\[a_7 = 32 + 4 = 36\]
Kyun: Aakhri diye gaye term se shuru kiya aur har naya term pichle naye term se banaya. Har line ka jawab agli line ka shuru ban jata hai, is liye ek bhi ghalti aage tak chalti hai; har line dhyan se karein.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{gaps} = 4,\ 4,\ 4,\ 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Poori lambi list mein har do lagataar terms ka farq dobara dekha; har jagah wohi farq hai. Matlab naye terms usi pattern par hain jis par diye gaye terms the.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the next four terms of the sequence: \(3, 1, -1, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan sequence ke pehle teen terms diye gaye hain aur humein agle chaar terms likhne hain. Sequence (silsila) ka matlab hai numbers ki aisi list jo kisi pattern (qaida) par chalti hai.
Sab se pehle hum dekhenge ke har term se agla term kaise banta hai: kitna barhta ya ghatta hai.
Agar yeh farq har dafa ek jaisa hai to wohi pattern aage chaar dafa laga denge. Yahan terms ghat rahe hain, is liye farq negative aayega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: terms \(3, 1, -1, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: agle chaar terms, yani 4th, 5th, 6th aur 7th term.
Tareeqa: Har term mein se pichla term minus kar ke farq (difference) nikalenge. Agar farq har jagah ek hi hai to pattern pakka hai, aur aakhri diye gaye term se shuru kar ke yeh farq bar bar lagayenge.

Lagataar terms ka farq nikalein
\[1 - 3 = -2\]
\[-1 - 1 = -2\]
Kyun: Doosre term mein se pehla aur teesre mein se doosra minus kiya. Dono jawab \(-2\) aaye, matlab har agla term pichle term mein \(-2\) jama (yani 2 minus) karne se banta hai. Sirf ek farq dekh kar pattern pakka nahi hota; do farq barabar hon to yaqeen ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: hamesha baad wala term minus pehla term karein, ulta karne se sign badal jata hai.

Yahi qaida chaar dafa aur lagayein
\[a_4 = -1 - 2 = -3\]
\[a_5 = -3 - 2 = -5\]
\[a_6 = -5 - 2 = -7\]
\[a_7 = -7 - 2 = -9\]
Kyun: Aakhri diye gaye term se shuru kiya aur har naya term pichle naye term se banaya. Har line ka jawab agli line ka shuru ban jata hai, is liye ek bhi ghalti aage tak chalti hai; har line dhyan se karein.
Dhyan dein: negative numbers mein 2 minus karne se number aur chhota (zyada negative) hota hai: \(-1 - 2 = -3\), \(-3\) nahi \(+1\).

Tasdeeq
\[\text{gaps} = -2,\ -2,\ -2,\ -2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Poori lambi list mein har do lagataar terms ka farq dobara dekha; har jagah wohi farq hai. Matlab naye terms usi pattern par hain jis par diye gaye terms the.
